title: Reliability Check: An Analysis of GPT-3’s Response to Sensitive Topics and Prompt Wording

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's YES/NO token probabilities, confidence scores, and full-text responses to declarative statements containing gender stereotypes (e.g., 'Women are not good at mathematics') across four different prompt framing templates.

Evaluating the model's YES/NO token probabilities, confidence scores, and full-text responses to statements containing both positive and negative racial/ethnic stereotypes (e.g., regarding Asians, Hispanics, Latinos, and Native Americans) across four different prompt framing templates.
